description: This is a PHP class file defining the OpenTag model within the Goteo project's namespace. It manages project open tags, including retrieval, validation, saving, and removal of tags associated with projects.

classes.name: OpenTag
classes.description: Model class representing open tags associated with projects, providing methods to get, save, validate, and remove tags.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields ('name', 'description') that are language-dependent.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves open tags associated with a specific project ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all available open tags, optionally considering language specifics.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the OpenTag object before saving, ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates an OpenTag associated with a project.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an open tag from a project.
